findings.source_quote: “But thou art he that took me out of the womb: thou didst make me hope when I was upon my mother’s breasts” (Ps 22:9).  ...  The Philistines “had filled them with earth” (Gen 26:15).
findings.suggested_fix: The Psalm 22:9 rendering in Arabic is acceptable but slightly non-idiomatic; consider rendering in standard liturgical/modern Arabic consistent with other scripture quotations in the translation. For Genesis 26:15, keep the quoted wording but match canonical Arabic punctuation/quotation style. Example for Psalm 22:9: «أَنْتَ أَنْتَ أَخْرَجْتَنِي مِنَ الرَّحِمِ؛ أَضَعْتَنِي عَلَى ثَدْيِ أُمِّي، فَأَمَلْتَنِي.» (مزمور 22:9). These are optional stylistic refinements — they do not change meaning.
findings.translation_quote: «أَنْتَ أَنْتَ أَخْرَجْتَنِي مِنَ الرَّحِمِ، جَعَلْتَنِي آمِلًا عَلَى ثَدْيِ أُمِّي» (مزمور 22:9).  ...  «مَلأَهَا الْفِلِسْطِينِيُّونَ تُرَابًا» (تكوين 26:15).
